notes:
Summary: OrbitWave builds a VS Code copilot extension (SaaS) aimed at small-to-mid dev teams. Primary differentiator is ultra-low-latency streaming completions (per-keystroke chunks) + workspace-level model pinning so teams can lock to tested model versions.

Key product asks / requirements (from CTO/eng leads):
- Streaming: websocket or SSE connection; chunked token streaming that merges with editor buffer without flicker. Must support resume/reconnect without losing partial completions.
- Latency target: 40-80ms median for local suggestions in NA; 120-250ms for EU depending on region routing. Critical for flow.
- Throughput: multi-user shared org pools; expect 150 concurrent active devs in peak for a 200-employee org.
- Rate limits: per-user and per-org throttling; prefer configurable token- and request-based limits with burst windows.
- Model/version pinning: ability to pin per-workspace or per-team to a specific model hash/version; rollback/canary for updates.
- Fallbacks: when pinned model unavailable, need policy: (1) deny + notify, or (2) fallback to compatible smaller model with explicit rate/cost delta reporting.
- Auth: SSO + org-scoped API keys for extension; short-lived ephemeral keys for the editor session.
- Data handling: must support redact-on-ingest for telemetry, and opt-in code snippet retention for evals. Legal wants clarity on retention windows and ability to purge.
- Security: enterprise SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs tied to token IDs, KM integration (bring-your-own-KMS).
- Offline dev mode: lightweight on-device model for basic completions (quantized) is a multi-quarter wishlist.

PoC notes / findings:
- Initial PoC used Redwood hosted endpoint; integration straightforward. Websocket streaming merged into editor buffer cleanly.
- Observed occasional throttling spikes in EU tests — need smart routing to EU region + automatic fallback to dedicated pool.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering lead "we need predictable unit economics; per-keystroke surprises are blockers for adoption". They favor options for batching intermediate tokens and caching common prefix completions.
- SE ask: fine-grained metrics (per-route latency, token cost per suggestion, per-user quota dashboards) to ship in eval.

- Perf: run a focused EU latency run with region pinning and canary fallback (target by 2026-03-25)
